title: Willpower Mastery Progression and Unlocks
description:
Purpose: XP-based progression to unlock construct families and upgrades (reduced drain, faster spawn, improved durability), loadout pinning, soft caps to prevent overpowering, and mastery challenges to encourage varied use.

Params (params_json):
- xp_curve (array/curve)
- unlock_tree (JSON): nodes with costs, prerequisites, and effects mapped to construct ids in promoted.ring_construct_core and extensions.
- soft_cap_rules: diminishing returns thresholds.

Behaviour:
1) Accumulate XP from missions/objectives; display progress on Construct Hall terminals.
2) Unlocks:
   - Spend XP to unlock categories and upgrades; propagate effects to construct modules (e.g., drain multipliers, cooldown reductions).
3) Loadouts:
   - Allow pinning favorites for quick access; expose to selection wheel as pinned shortcuts.
4) Persistence:
   - Save/load progression state via save_persistence.

Components:
- Reads/Writes: CProgressionState, CHUD (unlock notifications), integration events to ring_construct_core to enable newly unlocked items.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_progression_unlock_construct: unlock a family and verify availability in wheel.
- test_save_persistence: persists unlocks.

Integration and depends_on:
- Depends on mission_system for reward events and save_persistence for storage.
- Integrates with promoted.ring_construct_core to enable/disable families and to apply tuning params.

Scenes:
- construct_hall terminals, construct_hall_displays.

Suggested file split: progression_register.cpp, progression_tree.cpp, progression_integration_constructs.cpp, progression_persistence.cpp.
